propositions: DET caused_by floor must deterministically block epic close when an open or in_progress bug records a caused_by edge into the epic subtree, with a teaching message directing agents to fix, re-parent, or dispute the link.

Candidate filter must identify open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first open→in_progress STATUS event (with retired events included) OR linked to the epic subtree by any relation (any depth, both directions), capped at 32 with overflow tally.

Single-turn haiku screen must use model-class config and shared cache settings (warm then parallel fan-out), forced-choice A/B/C verdict with citation, forward only A-verdicts as compact candidates (title+citation+id, max 8 rows) to the verifier inside the precheck-assembled fenced context.

Verifier must block only defects-in-deliverable with NO recorded disposition: (a) supersedes or duplicates link to epic subtree or successor, or (b) reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose (bare 'out of scope' does not qualify).

Screen output must ride a registered epic_bug_screen_verdict schema with normalizing validator (default C on malformed/missing), and screen failure must degrade open (log + skip) never blocking the close.
Screen tally including per-candidate verdict and unevaluated-overflow count must be recorded in the completion sidecar for audit and live calibration.
